narrative.intro: Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligated $916M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Massachusetts Institute of Technology received 26 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $35.2M. Obligations fell 36.5% year over year. Massachusetts Institute of Technology has maintained multi-year presence in federal markets, with prior fiscal-year obligations of $1.5B in FY24 and $1.4B in FY25. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the dominant market, accounting for $809M of current obligations, followed by Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $107M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity, while largest-awards and expiring-contracts figures reported elsewhere represent total contract values. This profile highlights concentration in R&D work and a sharp year-over-year decline in obligations. Contractors and program managers should note award-count and average-award-size dynamics when assessing partner capacity and near-term workload at Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
